definitions.explanation: A person sent to a particular location on a special assignment, most commonly a journalist stationed abroad to report for a news organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{特派員|とくはいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work as a foreign correspondent.

examples.japanese: ロンドン{特派員|とくはいん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧です。
examples.english: This is a report from our London correspondent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新聞社|しんぶんしゃ}→新聞社：01639_shinbunsha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特派員|とくはいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{戦地|せんち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have experience being dispatched to a war zone as a newspaper correspondent.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly refers to journalists stationed abroad. Often heard in TV news broadcasts introducing reports from overseas bureaus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{特派員|とくはいん} (foreign correspondent)
- {特派員|とくはいん}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧ (correspondent's report)
- ⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧{特派員|とくはいん} (on-site correspondent)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧: reporter, journalist — general term
- {通信員|つうしんいん}: news correspondent — similar but less common
